name: fintrace-ai-monorepo
description: FinTrace AI - Automated Financial Micro-Audit & Ghost-Beneficiary Detection Engine

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
